summary: All six round-1 confirmed_blocking findings are closed in SKILL.md and the two new CLI tests, but the fix adds an undeclared set-status pr-open test seam with stale confirmation and a non-cruise publish gate that edits existing tests, breaking SC-004.

findings.summary: PrOpenGateTests drives the bin/factory set-status pr-open CLI, a test seam that plan.md does not declare and the Confirmed scope does not cover, so the pr-gate test scope is stale.
findings.evidence: ENG-4 and engineering.md 'Confirmed test scope'. plan.md 'Test seams' (lines 119-126) declares the pr gate only as factory_cli.checks.gate_violation into pr; the Confirmed line (plan.md line 131) lists no set-status seam. spec.md Clarifications line 15. tasks.md T007 seam (line 64). test_cruise.py PrOpenGateTests calls set-status pr-open at lines 567 and 586.
findings.fix: Either drop PrOpenGateTests together with the set-status gate (see SPEC-14), or declare the set-status pr-open seam in plan.md, obtain fresh protected confirmation, and re-record the Confirmed line.

findings.summary: cmd_set_status now refuses pr-open on the pr gate for every run, cruise or not, and two existing test modules were edited to inject approvals, which breaks SC-004's 'existing tests pass unchanged' and 'a run without --cruise behaves exactly as today'.
findings.evidence: spec.md SC-004. commands.py lines 1359-1363 add checks.gate_violation(s, 'pr') to cmd_set_status, not named in plan.md 'Source Code'. Existing tests edited: tools/tests/test_commands.py lines 668-683 and tools/tests/test_improvements.py lines 26-46 (approved() helper, applied at 46, 96, 120, 195, 264). The gate runs after git push and gh pr create, so it cannot stop them; the checkpoint approver --next pr gate already closes SEC-1 before any push.
findings.fix: Remove the cmd_set_status gate, PrOpenGateTests and the approved() injections in test_commands.py and test_improvements.py, restoring those tests unchanged. If kept, amend plan.md and SC-004 and confirm the new seam per SPEC-13.
